variants.name: 6 intro
variants.description: Six large pieces with sloped tops: a gentle first puzzle. Fill the square tray so the roof forms one continuous surface.
notes: Min-convention tropical polynomial over x, y in [-7, -1]; each piece is the region where one term attains the minimum.

variants.name: 6 intro (flat)
variants.description: The 6 intro footprints with the relief removed. Fill the square tray; heights give no clues.
notes: Min-convention tropical polynomial over x, y in [-7, -1]; each piece is the region where one term attains the minimum.
Roof relief removed: every piece has the same uniform thickness.
